articles.summary: Bold wavy stripes of orange and blue with a fine dotted grain, flowing like warped contour lines. Reads as loud orange-and-blue flowing zebra stripes; the dot grain disappears and only the two-colour contrast and the warped flow survive.

A fine dotted grain and a faint crosshatch run through both colours, and the orange bands carry darker red-brown cross bars. From a distance: Reads as loud orange-and-blue flowing zebra stripes; the dot grain disappears and only the two-colour contrast and the warped flow survive.
